title: Add cargo-deny advisories check to CI + deny.toml
description: CI (.github/workflows/main.yml, container-test.yml) has no dependency-audit step, which is how the advisory pile-up went unnoticed. Add a 'cargo deny check advisories' job (cargo-deny binary is already used locally; add via dtolnay/rust-toolchain or the official cargo-deny action). Add a deny.toml at repo root configuring the advisories section (deny vulnerabilities/unsound, warn unmaintained/yanked as appropriate). Run the same check in local dev docs.
close_reason: Added deny.toml (advisories: cargo-deny >=0.19 denies all advisories by default; licenses MIT/Apache-2.0 + permissives in tree; bans multiple-versions=warn; sources crates.io only). New 'deny' CI job via EmbarkStudios/cargo-deny-action@v2 (check advisories). All 4 cargo-deny checks pass locally.

title: Add unit/integration tests (get_crate_path, template, routes, hash verify)
description: Only unit tests exist: Input parsing in src/verify.rs. Add: (1) get_crate_path (src/crates.rs) - pure function, cover 1/2/3/4+ letter crate names + None; (2) index template render (src/serve.rs IndexTemplate) with unix/windows platforms; (3) HTTP route coverage via warp::test (static, dist, rustup, crates native+condensed formats, git, index); (4) download hash-verify paths in src/download.rs (matching/mismatching sha256). Aim for a basic integration test in tests/ too.

title: Replace blocking std::fs in download.rs with tokio::fs
description: src/download.rs uses blocking std::fs + std::fs::File inside async fns (create_file_create_dir, write_file_create_dir, one_download's f.write_all, copy_file_create_dir, move_if_exists*). Under crates.download_threads parallelism this blocks async runtime workers during large mirror syncs. Migrate to tokio::fs (AsyncReadExt/AsyncWriteExt already imported in the crate). Preserve retry/hash-verify semantics.

title: Bump git2 0.16 -> 0.21 to clear RUSTSEC-2024-0013 (libgit2 code-exec CVEs)
description: Cargo.lock pins libgit2-sys 0.14.2+1.5.1 / git2 0.16.1, flagged by 'cargo deny check advisories' as RUSTSEC-2024-0013 (memory corruption, DoS, arbitrary code execution; CVE-2024-0209/-0248/-2453/-5304). Bump git2 to >=0.19 (target 0.21.0, libgit2 1.9.7) in Cargo.toml. API for RemoteCallbacks/FetchOptions/RepoBuilder is compatible; verify sync_crates_repo, fast_forward, rewrite_config_json in src/crates_index.rs and Repository::open usage in src/crates.rs. libgit2-sys builds from source by default (no new system dep). Run cargo check + cargo deny check advisories after.
close_reason: git2 0.21.0 / libgit2-sys 0.18.8+1.9.7; RUSTSEC-2024-0013 cleared; cargo check/clippy/test pass

title: Bump remaining deps + dedupe futures (indicatif, env_logger, thiserror, tokio, include_dir, tokio-util, tokio-stream)
description: Bump to current stable: indicatif 0.17.8->0.18.6, env_logger 0.10.2->0.11.11, thiserror 1.0.61->2.0.21 (largely source-compatible), tokio 1.38->1.53.1, url 2.5.0->2.5.8, include_dir 0.7.3->0.7.4, tokio-util 0.7.11->0.7.19, tokio-stream 0.1.15->0.1.19. Cargo.toml declares BOTH 'futures' and 'futures-util' (0.3.30, yanked) - keep one (futures-util is used in serve.rs). Re-run cargo check/clippy/deny after each bump.
close_reason: indicatif 0.18.6, env_logger 0.11.11, thiserror 2.0.21, tokio 1.53.1, url 2.5.8, include_dir 0.7.4, tokio-util 0.7.19, tokio-stream 0.1.19; futures deduped

title: Bump reqwest 0.11 -> 0.12 (hyper 1.x; clears h2 + webpki advisories)
description: reqwest 0.11.27 sits on the hyper 0.14 stack. Bump to 0.12.x (0.12.28 line). This pulls h2 0.4.16+ (clears RUSTSEC-2026-0258) and rustls 0.23 (clears 4 rustls-webpki advisories) and un-yanks futures-util. Usage in src/download.rs (download_string, one_download), src/rustup.rs and src/crates.rs is mostly drop-in. Drop the unused 'blocking' feature in Cargo.toml (grep shows no blocking usage in src/).
close_reason: reqwest 0.12.28; blocking feature removed; verify.rs uses http crate; cargo check/clippy/test pass

title: Bump warp 0.3 -> 0.4 (hyper 1.x) in serve.rs
description: warp 0.3.7 sits on the deprecated hyper 0.14 stack; warp 0.4.3 uses hyper 1.x/hyper-util. Port src/serve.rs: warp::hyper::Body::channel/Sender -> hyper 1 + http-body-util streaming, Body::wrap_stream for get_crate_file, warp::body::stream in handle_git, TLS serve (.tls().cert_path().key_path()) still available in 0.4. Keep all routes: index, /static, /dist, /rustup, crates native+condensed formats, /git/crates.io-index (git http-backend CGI), /index sparse. NOTE: decision 2026-10-02 - stay on warp for now; see future-axum-migration backlog issue. Coordinate with bump-reqwest-012 (both land on hyper 1.x) and askama bump (drop askama_warp, render IndexTemplate manually with warp::reply::html).
close_reason: Migrated serve.rs to warp 0.4: Reply-based handlers, manual rustls TLS via hyper-util, reply::stream file streaming, git http-backend streaming. Verified: build, clippy, 18/18 tests, HTTP+TLS smoke tests (index, static, sparse, native+condensed crate download, git clone/push round-trip). Zero cargo-deny advisories.

title: Document unauthenticated git-push endpoint (serve.rs handle_git)
description: Decision 2026-10-02: document, don't gate. src/serve.rs handle_git exposes 'git http-backend' with no auth - anyone with the URL can push to the local crates.io-index repo. Add a clear security note to README (Server section) and a startup warning in the serve command output when TLS is NOT enabled (http:// exposed). Advise running behind a reverse proxy with auth for internet-facing mirrors. Do NOT add auth in this issue (tracked separately if ever desired).

title: Move to Rust edition 2024
description: Decision 2026-10-02: migrate edition 2021 -> 2024 in Cargo.toml. Requires MSRV >= 1.85 (set-msrv issue). Run cargo fmt (edition changes some formatting), cargo check/clippy, fix any edition-2024 breakages (e.g. unsafe_op_in_unsafe_fn, RPIT lifetime capture, gen keyword, if-let temp scope, match ergonomics, static mut refs, never type fallback). Coordinate with set-msrv-143.

title: Fix 'i586-pc-windows-msvc' typo -> i686 in PLATFORMS_WINDOWS
description: Decision 2026-10-02: it's a typo. src/rustup.rs:26 lists 'i586-pc-windows-msvc' in the allowed-platforms allowlist, but i586 has never been a Rust target (the real one is i686-pc-windows-msvc, already present at line 27). As-is, a mirror.toml pinning i586 would pass validation then 404 on download. Replace i586-pc-windows-msvc with i686-pc-windows-msvc (dedupe if it duplicates the existing entry). Verify against https://rust-lang.github.io/rustup/installation/other.html and add a unit test for the platform allowlist if feasible.

title: Future: migrate server from warp to axum (backlog note)
description: Backlog/decision note from 2026-10-02 audit: current decision is to bump warp 0.3->0.4 (hyper 1.x) rather than migrate now. However, askama officially removed all framework integration crates in 0.13 (askama_warp is published as deprecated), and axum is the ecosystem direction. If/when revisiting: replace warp filter chains in src/serve.rs with axum Router (routes: index, static, dist, rustup, crates native+condensed, git http-backend CGI, sparse index), port TLS via axum-server, use axum::response streaming. Keep as low-priority future work.

title: Add HTTP client timeouts (reqwest) to prevent infinite hangs
description: No timeouts anywhere: reqwest::Client::new() in src/download.rs (download_string, one_download), src/rustup.rs, src/crates.rs has no .timeout()/connect_timeout(). A dead peer hangs a download forever. Add reasonable connect + total request timeouts (consider making them configurable via mirror.toml). Keep per-chunk streaming.

title: Modernize CI workflows + fix TEST_TAG bug
description: main.yml + container-test.yml use deprecated actions-rs/toolchain@v1, actions-rs/cargo@v1, actions/checkout@v2, actions/cache@v2. Migrate to dtolnay/rust-toolchain, actions/checkout@v4, actions/cache@v4. Add a clippy job (currently only fmt+build; 'cargo clippy' yields 6 minor warnings). BUG: container-test.yml release job tags with ${{ env.TEST_TAG }} which is never defined -> empty tag; fix to use a real tag (e.g. image version / latest).
close_reason: main.yml: actions/checkout@v4, dtolnay/rust-toolchain@v1, Swatinem/rust-cache@v2, direct cargo runs; added test job; clippy -D warnings now enforced AND passing (fixed 6 pre-existing warnings: 3 dead_code wire-format fields in rustup.rs, 2 useless .into_iter(), 1 map_or->is_some_and). container-test.yml: checkout v4, docker/setup-qemu@v4, setup-buildx@v4, login@v4, build-push@v7; fixed TEST_TAG bug (undefined env -> empty tag) by tagging CONTAINER_NAME:latest.

title: Pin Docker base images (rust:1.96-slim + debian:12-slim)
description: Decision 2026-10-02: pin to rust:1.96-slim (builder) and debian:12-slim (runtime). Dockerfile currently uses unpinned 'rust:latest' + 'debian:latest' (reproducibility + supply-chain risk). Note: runtime apt installs ca-certificates, git, libssl3 (Debian 12 bookworm name - correct for 12-slim; will be libssl3t64 on trixie, another reason to pin 12). Keep multi-stage + git safe.directory. Update CI container-test.yml to match.
close_reason: Pinned builder to rust:1.96-slim and runtime to debian:12-slim (tags verified on Docker Hub). rust:slim lacks the C toolchain, so builder stage now installs build-essential/cmake/pkg-config/libssl-dev for aws-lc-rs, libgit2-sys and openssl-sys. ADD->COPY. Runtime keeps ca-certificates/git/libssl3 (correct bookworm names).

title: Add Range/ETag support to static file server (stretch)
description: src/serve.rs get_crate_file streams the whole file and sets only CONTENT_LENGTH - no Range/If-Modified-Since/ETag. Works for cargo/rustup but is a gap for generic HTTP clients and re-sync efficiency. Add Range request handling + ETag/Last-Modified on /crates, /dist, /rustup, /index. Backlog/stretch.

title: README cleanup (dup heading, section order, pinned docker tags)
description: README.md: duplicate '## Usage' heading (~line 20) with empty body; Docker section precedes the bare-metal Install/Init sections (reorder so Install -> Init -> Sync -> Serve); pin docker image tags in examples (panamaxrs/panamax:1.0.14 instead of implicit latest); verify proxy + nginx sample sections still match current CLI flags.

title: Reduce unwrap() in verify.rs/crates.rs (propagate errors)
description: 34 unwraps: src/verify.rs (24), src/crates.rs (10). Acknowledged TODO at src/crates.rs:94 ('There are still many unwraps in the foreach sections. This needs to be fixed.'). The git diff.foreach closure in sync_crates_files uses .unwrap() on path()/find_blob()/lines() and swallows failures. Convert hot paths to proper error propagation (collect errors or early-return) instead of panicking. Keep dev_reduced_crates feature behavior intact.

title: Replace ad-hoc toml_edit::easy parsing with typed serde structs (toml crate)
description: Decision 2026-10-02: remove toml_edit entirely. Current usage: (1) src/crates.rs vendor_path_to_mirror_entries - parses vendored Cargo.toml via toml_edit::easy::Value with .to_string().replace('"','') hacks; (2) src/crates.rs cargo_lock_to_mirror_entries - same for Cargo.lock; (3) src/mirror.rs create_mirror_toml - loads mirror.default.toml as toml_edit::Document, flips rustup.sync, writes back (format-preserving); (4) src/rustup.rs SyncError has toml_edit::de/ser variants + load_channel uses toml_edit::easy::from_str for channel toml. Migration: use the 'toml' crate (1.1.x) + serde typed structs (CrateManifest {package{name,version}}, CargoLock {package: Vec<{name,version,source,checksum}>}, Channel already a serde struct). For (3) create_mirror_toml: since default is our own file, read template, deserialize to Config, mutate, serialize with toml - acceptable. Bump or drop toml_edit from Cargo.toml accordingly.
close_reason: Removed toml_edit; added toml 1.1.6. Typed serde structs (VendoredCrate, CargoLock/CargoLockPackage) replace .to_string().replace('"','') hacks in crates.rs. toml::from_str/to_string replace toml_edit::easy in rustup.rs (channel/release/history) and mirror.rs. create_mirror_toml now renders the commented template verbatim, flipping only [rustup] sync when --ignore-rustup (parse/serialize round-trip would drop the 69 comment lines). 2 new unit tests guard render_mirror_config; verified panamax init output byte-identical to template modulo the sync line. 20/20 tests, clippy -D warnings, cargo deny all checks pass.

title: Set rust-version (MSRV) in Cargo.toml
description: Cargo.toml has no rust-version field and no rust-toolchain.toml, so the MSRV is undefined. Pick an MSRV (e.g. the minimum stable that supports the bumped deps - likely 1.85+ given edition 2024 / new dep MSRVs), add rust-version to [package], and add a CI job building with that toolchain to lock it in. Coordinate with the edition-2024 decision.

title: Update vulnerable/yanked transitive deps (openssl, bytes, url, idna, futures-util, spin)
description: 'cargo deny check advisories' reports: openssl 0.10.64 (RUSTSEC-2025-0004/-0022 UAF, -0009 panic), bytes 1.6.0 (RUSTSEC-2026-0007 overflow->UB) + yanked, rustls-webpki 0.102.4 (4 advisories: name constraints/CRL), idna 0.5.0 (RUSTSEC-2024-0421), h2 0.3.26 (RUSTSEC-2026-0258), tokio 1.38.0 (RUSTSEC-2026-0008). Several clear via plain 'cargo update -p <crate>' (openssl, bytes, url->2.5.8, idna->1.x, futures-util, spin). h2/webpki/tokio items clear together with the reqwest 0.12 + tokio bumps. Validate with 'cargo check' and 'cargo deny check advisories' until only accepted/unmaintained warnings remain.
close_reason: All 20+ rustsec advisories resolved: warp 0.4 (drops hyper 0.14/h2 0.3/rustls 0.22), git2 0.21 (libgit2 1.9), reqwest 0.12, bytes 1.11, thiserror 2, rustls-pki-types pem API (replaces unmaintained rustls-pemfile). cargo deny check advisories: OK.
